hooks.text: The video gets one frame longer every play.
hooks.note: Eight words. States the anomaly and implicates the viewer in it.

hooks.text: He has played the file eleven times. It is eleven frames longer.
hooks.note: Stronger specificity, but spends a second on the man before the strangeness.

hooks.text: The file never changes size. It keeps getting longer.
hooks.note: Nice contradiction, but needs a beat of technical understanding to land.

hook_rationale: Hook 1 is the only one that is fully legible before the viewer has decided to scroll. It contains the anomaly noun, a complete impossibility, and a second-person address that makes the viewer complicit in the mechanism that drives the story.
final_twist: The appended frames are not a glitch, they are continuous real time. The camera never stopped, and the ten thousand empty frames are twenty-two real years the file has been holding on to.
music_mood: Slow sub-bass pulse at roughly 60 bpm with a single detuned piano note. No melody, no drums. Drops to near silence at 0:33 and returns as a rising low drone under the final ten seconds.
sound_bed: Hard drive ticks, keyboard taps, tape hiss, room tone that cuts out completely twice.
